name: Al-Fakhoora School
post_war_status: Struck Nov 4 & Nov 18, 2023; 65+ killed across two strikes; thousands of displaced sheltering inside. Also shelled in 2009 and 2014 conflicts.
introduction: UNRWA-run primary school in Jabalia refugee camp, one of the most repeatedly targeted schools in Gaza.

name: Abu Hussein School (Girls)
post_war_status: Struck Nov 2, 2023 (20 killed); struck again Oct 17, 2024 (28+ killed, 160+ injured). Coords: Airwars ISPT0823.
introduction: UNRWA girls' primary school in Jabalia refugee camp, used as a shelter for displaced families during the war.

name: Osama bin Zaid School
post_war_status: Struck Nov 3, 2023; 20 killed, dozens injured; 1,000+ refugees inside per UNRWA and Gaza Ministry of Health.
introduction: UNRWA school in the Al-Saftawi area of northern Gaza, sheltering over 1,000 displaced residents at time of strike.

name: Al-Buraq School
post_war_status: Struck Nov 9, 2023; at least 50 killed when Israeli missile hit in the morning while thousands sheltered inside.
introduction: UNRWA school on Lababidi Street in the Al-Nasr neighbourhood of Gaza City, used as a displacement shelter.

name: Al-Falah School
post_war_status: Struck Nov 17, 2023; at least 20 killed. Due to communications blackout, rescue teams were unaware until the next day.
introduction: UNRWA school in the Al-Zaytoun neighbourhood of Gaza City, serving as a UNRWA displacement shelter.

name: Al-Tabaeen School
post_war_status: Struck Aug 10, 2024 with GBU-39 bombs; 80–93 killed, 47 injured. One of the deadliest single school attacks of the war. Al-Haq investigation found no evidence of military equipment on site.
introduction: Government school in the Al-Daraj area of eastern Gaza City with an attached mosque, located ~500m from Sahaba Medical Complex.

name: Maghazi UNRWA School
post_war_status: First struck Oct 17, 2023; 6 killed, dozens injured incl. UNRWA staff. 4,000+ refugees inside per UNRWA.
introduction: UNRWA school in Al-Maghazi refugee camp, central Gaza, sheltering over 4,000 people at the time of the first strike.

name: Maghazi Secondary Girls School
post_war_status: Struck Dec 27, 2023; at least 5 killed.
introduction: Government girls' secondary school in Al-Maghazi camp, central Gaza.

name: Haifa School
post_war_status: Struck Dec 15, 2023; 20+ killed. Al Jazeera photographer Samer Abu Daqqa killed; journalist Wael Al-Dahdouh injured.
introduction: UNRWA school in Khan Younis used as a displacement shelter. Site where Al Jazeera journalist Samer Abu Daqqa was killed.

name: An-Nazla Elementary School
post_war_status: Struck while hundreds sheltered; at least 10 killed including children. Eyewitness account (May 2024): 'Children were playing in the schoolyard, and suddenly we were bombed.'
introduction: Government elementary school in northern Gaza, bombed while hundreds of refugees sheltered inside.

name: Al-Sardi School
post_war_status: Struck Jun 6, 2024 at ~2am; two GBU-39 missiles hit top floor classrooms. 33–35 killed (9 children, 3 women, 21 men), 70+ injured. One victim named was an 8-year-old boy.
introduction: UNRWA school in Nuseirat refugee camp, sheltering approximately 6,000 displaced people at time of strike.

name: Al-Jawni School
post_war_status: Struck Jul 6, 2024 (16 killed, 2,000 sheltering); struck again Sep 11, 2024 (18 killed incl. 6 UNRWA staff, 44+ injured). Head of UNRWA stated two-thirds of all UNRWA schools in Gaza had been hit.
introduction: UNRWA-run school in Nuseirat refugee camp, used as a polio vaccination centre the week before it was struck.

name: Al-Awda School
post_war_status: Struck Jul 9, 2024; GBU-39 bomb hit the gate. 31+ killed (mostly women and children), 53+ injured. Fourth school attack in four days.
introduction: UNRWA school in Abasan al-Kabira village east of Khan Younis, converted to displacement shelter for Rafah evacuees.

name: Khadija Girls' School
post_war_status: Struck Jul 26–27, 2024; at least 3 airstrikes using US munitions. 30–53 killed incl. 15 children and 8 women, 100+ injured. HRW found no evidence of military target.
introduction: Government girls' secondary school west of Deir al-Balah city, sheltering ~4,000 displaced with an attached field hospital.

name: Rufaida Girls' High School
post_war_status: Struck Oct 10, 2024; 28+ killed incl. 2 children, 54+ injured. Third school attack in Deir al-Balah in one week. Coords from Wikipedia geohack.
introduction: Government girls' secondary school in Deir al-Balah, used as a shelter and a UNICEF malnutrition treatment point.

name: Holy Family School
post_war_status: Struck Jul 7, 2024; 4 killed. Part of wider Latin Patriarchate complex in Gaza City.
introduction: Latin Patriarchate-owned Catholic private school in Gaza City, housing hundreds of refugees from the war.

name: Shadia Abu Ghazala School
post_war_status: Documented as attacked during the Gaza war. Beit Lahia subject to intense bombardment in Oct–Nov 2024.
introduction: Government school in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza, documented as struck during the war.

name: Fahmi al-Jarjawi School
post_war_status: Struck May 25, 2025; 36+ killed including 18 children and 6 women, 55+ injured. Attack widely condemned internationally.
introduction: Government school in the Daraj neighbourhood of Gaza City, used as a displacement shelter.

name: Al-Farabi School
area: Southwest Gaza City, near al-Yarmouk Stadium
post_war_status: Struck Sep 7, 2025 in early morning; 8 killed including several children, two rockets used per witnesses.
introduction: Government school in southwestern Gaza City near the al-Yarmouk Stadium, used as a shelter.

name: Ibn Rushd School
post_war_status: Struck Oct 6, 2024 alongside adjacent mosque; 26+ killed, 93+ injured. Sheltering displaced families at time of strike.
introduction: Government school adjacent to Shuhada al-Aqsa mosque in Deir al-Balah, struck simultaneously with the mosque.

name: Fatima Bint Asad School
post_war_status: Struck Oct 9, 2024 at ~6:45pm; artillery strike caused civilian casualties. Coords: Airwars ISPT091024v (31.538711, 34.495107).
introduction: School in Jabalia al-Balad, northern Gaza. Coords sourced from Airwars incident report ISPT091024v.

name: British International School (BIS Gaza)
post_war_status: Closed Oct 7, 2023 due to the war. Founded 2016. Coords from Wikipedia. Website: bis.edu.ps
introduction: Private international school in the Tel Al Hawa neighbourhood of Gaza City, founded in 2016 offering British A-levels and American GED qualifications.

name: Khuza'a Martyrs Secondary School
post_war_status: Coords from gis.unicef and Google Maps
introduction: Government school in Kuza'a town in Khan Younis govornate, 500 meters (.3 miles) from the Green Line. Seperate boys and girls school on the same campus.

name: Abasan Basic School
post_war_status: Coords from gis.unicef and Google Maps
introduction: Government school in Abasan al-Kabira, Khan Younis

name: Abasan Al Jadeeda Basic School
post_war_status: Coords from gis.unicef and Google Maps
introduction: Government school in Abasan al-Jadeeda al-Saghira, Khan Younis

name: Abbas Mahmoud Al Akkad Basic and Secondary Girls School
post_war_status: Coords from gis.unicef and Google Maps
introduction: Government school in Al-Nasser, Rafah. Primary and secondary education for girls
